purpose: Use HKEX as an independent official structural/linkage cross-check for Southbound eligibility publication without allowing HKEX to silently override SSE/SZSE primary eligibility authority.

SH.label_contains: List of Eligible Securities for Southbound Trading under Shanghai Connect

SZ.label_contains: List of Eligible Securities for Southbound Trading under Shenzhen Connect

pass_conditions: HKEX official page is reachable or successfully rendered through official-domain browser fallback.
All Eligible Securities heading is present.
Both Shanghai Connect and Shenzhen Connect Southbound link labels are present.
Each Southbound link resolves to the configured official SSE/SZSE landing URL or an equivalent URL on the same configured primary official domain.
HKEX page update date is parseable, not in the future, and no more than max_page_update_lag_days behind the validation date.
No conflict attempts to mutate SSE/SZSE primary membership or order state.
fail_closed_conditions: Either required Southbound link is missing.
A required link points outside the configured primary official domain.
HKEX page update date is unparseable, future-dated, or too stale.
HKEX wording/structure no longer proves it is presenting Southbound eligibility references.
